verdict.rationale: Bento claims releases are scored against production history offline and in CI (bentolabs-docs-14), which implies some programmatic eval capability. Its CLI claims dashboard parity for scripts and CI, with JSON output an agent can read (bentolabs-docs-30, bentolabs-docs-32), and agent skills give coding agents an integration playbook (bentolabs-docs-1). However, no evidence documents creating datasets or a specific command or API for triggering an eval run and reading back its results, and no OpenAPI spec was found (bentolabs-probe-2). Missing for 10: dataset creation API/CLI, documented eval-run trigger command, eval-results retrieval endpoint, hands-on corroboration.
